title: Harden release bundle and bootstrap path

context.summary: Add a repeatable release bundle generator and harden shell/PowerShell bootstrap extraction for local and hosted release manifests.
context.background: The installer can prepare, start, provision and manage local lifecycle operations. The bootstrap path now needs a concrete bundle layout, manifest generation and safer staging before public release work.

in: Add a release bundle builder that emits a tar.gz bundle and env-style manifest with SHA-256.
Include the source-style runtime, installer, Compose assets, docs and task metadata in the bundle while excluding local build outputs and dependencies.
Support local paths, file:// URLs and remote URLs in bootstrap bundle download.
Extract release bundles into a staging directory and promote only after successful extraction.
Improve bootstrap diagnostics for checksum, extraction and promotion failures.
Validate bootstrap scripts and generated release manifests in the dry-run acceptance path.
Document release bundle creation and local manifest testing.

acceptance_criteria: A `pnpm release:bundle -- --version <version>` command creates a release tarball and manifest.
The manifest includes release version, bundle URL and bundle SHA-256.
Bootstrap scripts accept local bundle paths or file:// URLs in addition to hosted URLs.
Bootstrap extraction uses temporary staging and does not overwrite an existing release directory until extraction succeeds.
Bootstrap validation builds a temporary bundle and verifies the generated manifest checksum.
Installer and deployment docs describe the release bundle and bootstrap test path.

manual_checks: Confirm release publishing and signing are not implemented in this task.

risks: Release bundles must not include node_modules, local demo data or other machine-specific build outputs.
Bootstrap promotion must not destroy a previously extracted release when extraction fails.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
